test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

DELIBERATE
solution:
The correct answer is **Spontaneous.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Deliberate **is an **adjective **that means *done it slowly without any hurry.*__
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows -
 __
 
• **Thoughtful -** Thinking deeply.
 
• **Illiterate - **Not able to read and write.
 
• **Spontaneous - **Done or happening suddenly.
 
• **Careful - **Giving a lot of attention.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that **Spontaneous** is the correct antonym of the word **Deliberate.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• Deliberate एक adjective है, इसका मतलब है बिना किसी हड़बड़ी के धीरे-धीरे करना ।
 
• दिए गए विकल्पों के अर्थ इस प्रकार हैं -
 
 
• Thoughtful - गहराई से सोचना ।
 
• Illiterate - पढ़ने-लिखने में सक्षम नहीं होना ।
 
• Spontaneous - अचानक हुआ या होनेवाला।
 
• Careful - बहुत ध्यान देना ।
 
 
 
• उपरोक्त अर्थों से स्पष्ट है कि Spontaneous शब्द का सही विलोम Deliberate है I

58:T14e6,

The correct answer is option 3.
